title: Common mistake: indexOf in an if
why_it_matters: -1 is truthy, so a missing item can pass the check.
explanation: To check whether an array holds something, includes gives a clear true or false. indexOf returns a position, and -1 when the item is missing. Since -1 is truthy, if (list.indexOf(x)) is wrong in both directions: missing passes, and position 0 fails.
try_it: Replace one indexOf check in your code with includes.
